blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The more than half-billion-peso Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot remained unwon after no bettor picked the winning number combination in Ultra Lotto’s biggest jackpot drawn on Sunday, Nov. 15, by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 26-33-18-46-15-14, with a jackpot prize of P537.91 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. This is according to the PCSO results. Aside from the Ultra Lotto, no bettor also won the more than a hundred-million-peso jackpot of the other major game drawn on Sunday, the Super Lotto 6/49. READ: Lotto results for Nov. 15, […]...
